blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The resumption of the budget deliberations on Friday began with a lighthearted exchange, with Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian mentioning the #WinRi trend. “Dahil uso ang WinRi ngayon, ang magbubukas si Win at si Ri,” Gatchalian said. (Because WinRi is such a trend now, Win and Ri will open today’s session.) WinRi is a viral social media fan-created pairing, combining the names of Gatchalian and Sen. Risa Hontiveros. Hontiveros moved that the Senate resume its consideration of the 2027 General Appropriations Bill and tackle the budget of the Judiciary and its offices. Sen.
